feature.label: Neovim for Eclipse
feature.description:
Vim mode for Eclipse, powered by a real Neovim: motions, operators, text objects, macros, registers and : commands, with your own init.lua, in Eclipse's text editors.
Requires: - Neovim 0.12.6 or newer, installed separately: the release archive from github.com/neovim/neovim/releases extracted into ~/.local/share/neovim4eclipse-plugin/neovim, nvim on the PATH, or its folder set in Window > Preferences > Neovim - Eclipse 2024-12 (4.34) or newer, on Java 21 or newer
https://github.com/Jm6CnDDXBwFTakS/neovim4eclipse
